value.rationale: Refining the classical finite-length Markov-type/profile count by off-diagonal transition support is motivated by sparse observed k-mers and transition-limited sequence reconstruction. It yields exact all-length formulas, a genuine support gap, and sharp, nonmonotone first-appearance thresholds (five types require seven positions, whereas six types need six). Unlike an arbitrary small-instance table it gives full information in a new natural parameter; only length-2 ternary cyclic profiles are claimed.
